description: Locked settings for the paper_benchmarks extension runs (stage 3). All conventions identical to the corrected single-gate campaign (protocol compress_rightcanon_ltr+var_multistart+tdvp_n1_v1).

single_gate_extension.reused_cells: rzz seed 11 taken unmodified from raw/single_gate_corrected/results.sqlite
single_gate_extension.angle_grid: config.build_generic_angle_grid() + build_special_angles() from experiments/single_gate/config.py (24 log-spaced generic x in [1e-4, 1] excluding specials, plus x in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}); x = theta/(2 pi)

substep_study.cap_nonbinding_evidence: peak bond 16 < 32 and discarded weight < 1e-13 for all rows

circuits_1d.description: 1D chain circuit benchmarks; the TDVP method applies EVERY two-qubit gate through the gate-local TDVP window update (gate_mode=full-tdvp), no direct nearest-neighbour contraction.

ising_1d.hamiltonian: H = -J sum Z_i Z_{i+1} - g sum X_i

circuits_1d.trotter_layout: bond(dt/2) [even bonds then odd bonds], field(dt), bond(dt/2); Heisenberg bond axis order rzz, rxx, ryy as in the 2D benchmark
circuits_1d.exact_reference: dense application of the identical Trotter circuit (raw_new/circuits_1d/exact_*_t30.npy)
circuits_1d.note: all two-qubit gates are nearest-neighbour, so tebd_swap inserts no SWAPs and mpo_zipup reduces to the identical direct SVD update (trajectories coincide)

determinism.checkpointing: sqlite task_id = sha256(canonical task payload); resume skips completed tasks
